$comment: The spirit tree network, played by plugins/world/SpiritTrees.plugin.js (docs/spirit-trees.md). `trees` are in the menu's order, as live OSRS lists them (rsprox capture database, https://rsprox.net/database, rev 237-238). `tree` is where the tree stands (Wiki); `landing` where travelling there puts the player (captured where recorded, else beside the tree). Permanent trees may need a quest (`requires`, enforced only for quests this server has) or a skill (`skills`); `grown` trees are farming patches, usable once grown and checked; `house` is a player-owned house's tree; `mooredAt` requires a prior moor at that Sailing dock id. Requirements from https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Spirit_tree.
